Compound interest = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ - P

The value of each instalment is Rs. 6655.

questions.question: If the speed of light in water and glass are 2.25 x 10⁸m/s and 1.86 x 10⁸m/s respectively then the refractive index of glass with respect to water is:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1.21.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Refractive index **is defined as the **ratio of the speed of light in vacuum to the speed of light in a medium.**
 
• Therefore, the refractive index of glass with respect to water can be calculated as the ratio of the speed of light in water to the speed of light in glass.
 
• **Refractive index = speed of light in vacuum / speed of light in medium.**
 
• Refractive index of glass with respect to water = Speed of light in water / Speed of light in glass = 2.25 x 108 / 1.86 x 108 = **1.21**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The refractive index of a medium is a measure of how much the speed of light is reduced when it passes through that medium, compared to the speed of light in a vacuum.
 
• In mathematical formulae and descriptive texts, the letter n or n' is most frequently used to represent the refractive index variable.
 
• The amount of light path bending, or refractive index, that occurs when light enters a substance is determined by this number.

questions.question: A tree is 10 m in front of a convex mirror of focal length 2.5 m. Its image is formed:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2.0 m behind mirror.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A convex mirror always forms a virtual, diminished, and erect image of the object placed in front of it.
 
• The **focal length of a convex mirror is always positive**, which means that the mirror is diverging in nature.
 
• Using the mirror formula,** 1/f = 1/v + 1/u,** where **f **is the focal length, **u **is the object distance, and **v** is the image distance, we can find the image distance for the given problem.
 
• Here, the **object distance is -10 m **and the **focal length is 2.5 m**.
 
• By substituting these values in the formula, we get **v = 2.0 m**, which means that the **image is formed 2.0 m behind the mirror.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A convex mirror is also known as a diverging mirror as it diverges the light rays.
 
• The image formed by a convex mirror is always virtual, diminished, and upright.
 
• The principal focus of a convex mirror is a point on the principal axis where the light rays appear to diverge from after reflecting from the mirror.
 
• The focal length of a convex mirror is always negative, and it is equal to half of the radius of curvature of the mirror.

(6 + 8 + 5 + 3 + 1) - (7 + 9 + 4 + 2) = 23 - 22 = 1, hence it will not be divisible by 11 either.

Divisibility of 3: The sum of digits should be divisible by 3.

6 + 7 + 8 + 9 + 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 45, which is divisible by 3.

**The answer is 3.**

Consider the below statements and identify the correct answer.

__
 
• **Electrovalent compounds **are also known as ionic compounds.
 
• These compounds are **formed between a metal and a non-metal through the transfer of electrons.**
 
• The metal loses electrons to form a positively charged ion (cation) while the non-metal gains electrons to form a negatively charged ion (anion).
 
• The resulting ions attract each other through electrostatic forces to form a stable compound.
 
• They are** soluble in water** due to the polar nature of water molecules.
 
• They are **insoluble in non-polar** solvents such as **kerosene and petrol.​**

• **Ionic or electrovalent bonds** are created when atoms exchange electrons to establish a bond between them.
 
• It can **only occur between non-metals and metals.**
 
• It cannot develop between two non-metals.
 
• It is formed between atoms when **electronegativity** varies greatly.
 
• It is the** strongest **of all the bonds.

__
 
• The **differing angles of refraction for different wavelengths of light **cause white light to be refracted and split into various colors when it passes through a triangular prism.
 
• The number of colors that are visible depends on the angle at which the light enters and exits the prism, as well as the thickness and material of the prism. Typically, **white light is split into seven colors when passing through a triangular prism.**
 
• The colors that are visible to the human eye are red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet. These colors are commonly remembered using the acronym **VIBGYOR.**
 
• The phenomenon of **splitting light into its constituent colors is called dispersion.​**

• In the field of optics, a prism is a transparent substance, such as glass, that has been precisely cut with plane faces and angles.

 
 
• It is used to reflect and analyze light. 
 
• A standard triangular prism can divide white light into its component colors, or what is known as a spectrum.
 
 
 
• The bending of light as it moves from one transparent substance into another is known as refraction.
 
 
• The bending caused by refraction allows us to create rainbows, prisms, magnifying glasses, and lenses.
 
• Our eyes are dependent on this light bending as well.

questions.question: One pipe can fill a tank three times as fast as another pipe. Together the two pipes can fill the tank in 32 minutes. The slower pipe alone will be able to fill the tank in _______ minutes.
questions.solution:
Given:

One pipe can fill a tank three times as fast as another pipe, and together they can fill the tank in 32 minutes.

Concept:

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken.

Total work = Efficiency × time

Calculation:

The ratio of efficiency of two pipes = 3: 1

Total work = (3 + 1) × 32

⇒ 4 × 32 = 128

Time taken by slower pipe alone = 128/1

⇒ 128 min

∴ The slower pipe alone will be able to fill the tank in 128 min.
